masterBacklogAdditions.title: Employment-status eligibility gate
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Extract student-only, disability-only, licence/certification-only and similar legal/status constraints into explicit hard or soft eligibility fields before ranking, preventing superficially good part-time jobs from being promoted when the employment status does not fit.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Technical scope evidence-gap score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: For WordPress/WooCommerce roles, separate operational CMS competence from server/PHP/database engineering and score each required technical cluster against evidence in the candidate profile; demote roles where multiple mandatory clusters lack evidence even when keyword overlap is high.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
